title: Sagāthakam
text: 2. Catuhi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato ariyasāvako sotāpanno hoti avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyano || katamehi catuhi || || [page 405] Saṃyutta-Nikāya. 405 3. Idha bhikkhave ariyasāvako Buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti || Iti pi so Bhagavā || la-pe || satthā devamanussānam buddho bhagavā ti || Dhamme || Saṅghe || Ariyakantehi sīlehi samannāgato hoti akhaṇḍehi || la-pe || samādhisaṃvattanikehi || || Imehi kho bhikkhave catuhi dhammehi samannāgato ariyasāvako sotāpanno hoti avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyano ti || || 4. Idam avoca Bhagavā || || Yassa saddhā Tathāgate || acaḷā suppatiṭṭhitā || sīlaṃ ca yassa kalyāṇaṃ || ariyakantam pasaṃsitaṃ |||| Saṅghe pasādo yassatthi || ujubhūtaṃ ca dassanaṃ || Adaliddo ti tam āhu || amoghaṃ tassa jīvitaṃ |||| Tasmā saddhañca sīlañca || pasādaṃ dhammadassanaṃ || anuyuñjetha medhāvī || saram buddhānasāsanan ti ||||
